suppressed.title: Import of 'unsafe' package detected
suppressed.description: File internal/engine/unlink_darwin.go imports the 'unsafe' package. Unsafe pointers bypass Go memory and boundary protections.
suppressed.preconditions: Attacker triggers code path utilizing unsafe memory pointers.
suppressed.attack_path: Type confusion, out-of-bounds pointer arithmetic, or garbage collection memory corruption.
suppressed.impact: Memory safety violation, potential arbitrary read/write, or process crash.
suppressed.recommendation: Avoid 'unsafe' in core storage paths. Use standard slices and encoding primitives.
suppressed.suppression_reason: Audited OS-specific atomic unlinkat syscall requiring unsafe.Pointer for raw uintptr syscall arguments

suppressed.title: Import of pseudo-random generator 'math/rand' in production code
suppressed.description: File cmd/lattice-bench/runner.go imports 'math/rand'. For cryptographic tokens, session keys, and election nonces, 'crypto/rand' must be used.
suppressed.preconditions: Attacker observes pseudo-random sequence to predict future values.
suppressed.attack_path: Predictable state transitions, nonce reuse, or session hijacking.
suppressed.recommendation: Use 'crypto/rand' for security-sensitive entropy, or document algorithmic pseudo-randomness (e.g. SkipList level generation).
suppressed.suppression_reason: Synthetic benchmark load generator using math/rand for repeatable Zipfian distribution generation
